However, it fails significant functional checkpoints: the text is illegible gibberish (not valid branding/logos), and the surface appearance deviates from the standard matte black due to the large, poorly rendered graphic. These failures prevent it from achieving high alignment, as a real hockey puck would have legible, standardized markings or be plain black.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is text_gibberish (severity 4), which is a hallmark of AI generation when attempting to render text. The central logo exhibits texture anomalies (severity 2) with soft, smeared edges rather than sharp print boundaries. While the overall structure is solid (high topology mask confidence), the surface details reveal generative flaws.
